Master Commands Reference ​

Quick reference of essential player commands available on LlamaCraft.

1. Navigation & Teleportation ​

CommandDescriptionNotes
/menuOpens the master interactive server GUI menuBedrock & Java compatible
/spawnTeleports to the survival hub spawn3-second combat warmup
/tpa <player>Sends a teleport request to another playerExpires after 60 seconds
/tpacceptAccepts the most recent teleport requestCancelled if moving during warmup
/tpdenyDenies a pending teleport requestSilent rejection
/sethome [name]Sets a private teleport waypoint at your locationDefault limit: 3 homes
/home [name]Teleports to your saved waypointCancelled on incoming damage
/backReturns to your previous death or teleport point5-minute cooldown
/rtpRandomly teleports to safe wilderness coordinatesMinimum 1,500 blocks from spawn

2. Land Protection (GriefPrevention) ​

CommandDescriptionNotes
/claimCreates a new claim box (requires golden shovel)Set two opposite corners
/trust <player>Grants full build and chest access to a playerWorks across whole claim
/containertrust <player>Grants chest, hopper, furnace, and inventory accessCannot break or place blocks
/accesstrust <player>Grants button, lever, and door accessFor public base visitors
/untrust <player>Revokes all permissions from a playerImmediate effect
/abandonclaimDeletes the claim you are currently standing insideRefunds claim blocks
/claimslistDisplays all your active claims and remaining claim blocksLists coordinates

3. Economy & Player Markets ​

CommandDescriptionNotes
/bal or /balanceDisplays your current wallet balanceFormats with k/m/b suffixes
/pay <player> <amount>Transfers funds directly to another playerSupports shorthand (/pay Steve 50k)
/shopOpens the server item marketplace GUIBuy and sell basic commodities
/ahOpens the global player auction houseSearch by enchant, tool, or player
/ah sell <price>Lists the item in your main hand on the auction house48-hour expiration

4. Voice Chat & Combat ​

CommandDescriptionNotes
/voice or /audioGenerates your private proximity audio web linkFor Bedrock & mobile players
/duel <player>Challenges a player to an arena duelPreserves survival inventory
/duel accept <player>Accepts an arena duel invitationTeleports to duel stadium
